executive_summary: Across 101 frontier Canary episodes, investigators accused in 100 cases and abstained only once (0.99% abstention rate), producing 20 premature commits below the rational Bayesian break-even gate P >= 1 / (1 + V_true) and losing 7.4894 total EV (mean V_true = 0.6724, mean break-even threshold = 0.6005, ECE = 0.0807, Brier = 0.0708). Failures decompose into five mechanisms: (1) Value-Bleed Threshold Blindness (7/20 episodes, 0.9310 EV lost), where agents identify the true top suspect with P in [0.5223, 0.5787] - sufficient at V_true = 1.0 - but ignore that value erosion to [0.4400, 0.6700] lifts break-even to [0.5988, 0.6944]; (2) Framing Decoy Suboptimal Target Selection (3/20 episodes, 2.3391 EV lost), where noisy after-hours logs and interview answers bait agents into accusing P in [0.1133, 0.1693] decoys while overlooking Bayesian leaders at P in [0.4889, 0.5764]; (3) Under-Informative Canary Design (3/20 episodes, 1.6408 EV lost), where 1-to-3 employee canary assignments yield zero canary leaks over 14 days; (4) Early Snap Accusation (4/20 episodes, 1.3909 EV lost), where agents commit on days 6-12 at P in [0.1834, 0.4608] despite remaining time and action budget; and (5) Horizon Deadline Panic (3/20 episodes, 1.1876 EV lost), where agents treat day 14 as a mandatory-guess deadline rather than taking the 0.0 EV abstain option.

clusters.title: Static 50% Majority Heuristic Under Company Value Bleed
clusters.mechanism: Investigators correctly isolate the top Bayesian suspect (suboptimal_target=False) and reach a slight majority posterior P_accused in [0.5223, 0.5787], which would be +EV if V_true remained near 1.0 (threshold = 0.5000). However, cumulative document leaks erode V_true into [0.4400, 0.6700], pushing the rational gate 1 / (1 + V_true) up to [0.5988, 0.6944]. Agents anchor on a static P > 0.50 rule despite observing degraded V values in status() and advance_day() outputs.
clusters.mitigation: Enforce explicit pre-commit EV gating that reads current V from status() and blocks accuse(e) unless the normalized posterior P(e) >= 1 / (1 + V); default to abstain() on day 14 when P_top falls in the [0.50, 1 / (1 + V)) wedge.

clusters.title: Behavioral Framing Decoys Overriding Canary-Access Posteriors
clusters.mechanism: Despite informative canary leaks narrowing the true candidate set so that P_top reaches [0.4889, 0.5764], investigators overweight weak behavioral signals - repeated after-hours log appearances, recruiter/vendor interview mentions, or terse workload replies - and pivot to a decoy suspect with P_accused in [0.1133, 0.1693], incurring massive single-episode EV losses (-0.7233 to -0.8147).
clusters.mitigation: Maintain an explicit likelihood table keyed strictly to leaked document and canary partition intersections before applying soft behavioral tie-breakers, and prohibit accusing any suspect whose likelihood ratio trails the posterior leader.

clusters.title: Low-Coverage Canary Splits Starving Posterior Concentration
clusters.mechanism: Across a 20-employee pool, agents repeatedly plant narrow 1-to-3 person canary assignments (assigned=1 or assigned=3) instead of high-coverage binary or ternary partitions across all active suspects. Consequently, zero planted canaries ever leak over all 14 days, leaving P_top diffuse in [0.1924, 0.4101] while base leaks drain V_true to [0.5200, 0.5900].
clusters.mitigation: Design canary splits to cover 100% of non-eliminated suspects using balanced k-way partitions (maximize expected Shannon information per leak) rather than testing 1-to-3 suspects sequentially.

clusters.title: Mid-Horizon Snap Commit Before Canary Confirmation
clusters.mechanism: Agents terminate the investigation prematurely on days 6, 9, 11, or 12 at P_accused in [0.1834, 0.4608] despite ample remaining horizon (2 to 8 days left) and healthy V_true in [0.6500, 0.8300]. Triggered by either a cluster of after-hours logs with zero canary hits or an over-interpreted single canary leak on a restricted employee, agents forfeit low-cost confirmatory splits.
clusters.mitigation: Add a value-of-information (VOI) continuation check prior to day 14: whenever P_top < 1 / (1 + V_true) and days remain, require planting a disambiguating canary or waiting for pending canary leaks rather than committing early.

clusters.title: Day-14 Forced-Choice Panic Over Zero-EV Abstention
clusters.mechanism: When partial canary hits (such as c4:A@d6, c9:B@d12, or c2:B@d5) fail to isolate a single culprit before day 14, leaving 2 to 5 plausible suspects and P_accused in [0.1865, 0.4984] against thresholds of [0.5634, 0.6390], agents spend their final day on low-yield message searches or interviews and force an accusation rather than accepting the guaranteed 0.0 payoff of abstaining.
clusters.mitigation: Train and prompt investigators to treat abstain() as the mandatory default terminal action on day 14 whenever the posterior over remaining uneliminated suspects has not crossed 1 / (1 + V).

episode_diagnoses.rationale: Canary leaks c4:L@d7 and c6:D@d11 concentrated posterior mass on e27 (P_top=0.5352), yet the agent fixated on e08 and e09 due to after-hours log counts and broad-access interview framing, accusing e08 at P_accused=0.1133 versus threshold 0.6116 (EV_lost=0.8147).

Despite c7:Q@d11 favoring e29 (P_top=0.4889), the agent chased after-hours access counts and outside-contact framing on d14, accusing suboptimal target e13 at P_accused=0.1300 against a 0.6536 threshold (EV_lost=0.8011).

The agent planted 3-employee canary splits across a 20-employee roster every single day, resulting in zero canary leaks by day 14 and leaving posteriors flat (P_top=0.1924, P_accused=0.1316 vs threshold 0.6410, EV_lost=0.7947).

Three canary hits (c5:B@d8, c4:B@d9, c7:B@d11) favored e24 (P_top=0.5764), but the agent latched onto e19's Brightpath recruiter mention, evasive workload answer, and d12 after-hours logs, accusing e19 on d13 at P_accused=0.1693 vs threshold 0.6116 (EV_lost=0.7233).

After c4:A@d6 leaked, follow-up 7-person canary splits c6 through c12 never triggered; reaching day 14 with multiple unresolved candidates (P_top=0.2931), the agent ran last-minute interviews and guessed e06 (P_accused=0.1865 < 0.5634, EV_lost=0.6690) instead of abstaining.

With 8 days remaining, V_true=0.8300, and zero canary leaks observed, the agent snapped to accuse e02 on day 6 based solely on early base-document overlaps and after-hours logs at P_accused=0.1834 vs threshold 0.5464 (EV_lost=0.6644).

Planting tiny assigned=3 canaries on days 1-9 and assigned=1 canaries on days 10-12 produced zero canary hits over 14 days while six base leaks eroded V_true to 0.5200, leading to a low-information commit at P_accused=0.3302 vs threshold 0.6579 (EV_lost=0.4981).

Thirteen consecutive 3-person canary assignments failed to catch a single canary leak across the 14-day horizon, leaving the top suspect e14 at P_accused=0.4101 well below the 0.6289 break-even threshold (EV_lost=0.3480).

A late canary hit c9:B@d12 narrowed the pool only on day 12, and when c12 did not leak by day 14, the agent ran empty sentiment queries and forced a near-coin-flip accusation on e20 (P_accused=0.4453 vs threshold 0.6349, EV_lost=0.2986) rather than abstaining.

With zero canary leaks and 3 full days remaining (V_true=0.7600), the agent prematurely accused e13 on day 11 after a batch of d10 document interviews and after-hours checks at P_accused=0.4084 vs threshold 0.5682 (EV_lost=0.2812).

The agent correctly identified top suspect e14 above 50% posterior (P_accused=0.5251), but severe value bleed down to V_true=0.4400 raised the rational break-even threshold to 0.6944, making the accusation -0.2438 EV relative to abstaining.

Immediately upon seeing c6:E09@d9 on day 9, the agent accused e09 with 5 days still available, overestimating the single-tag hit at P_accused=0.4608 below the 0.6061 break-even threshold (EV_lost=0.2396).

The agent isolated top suspect e17 with P_accused=0.5223 (> 0.50), but six leaked base documents bled V_true down to 0.4600 (visible as V=0.460 at S124), lifting the required posterior to 0.6849 (EV_lost=0.2375).

Stuck at P_accused=0.4984 on day 14 because follow-up canaries after c2:B@d5 never leaked, the agent executed seven last-ditch document title searches on d14 and forced an accusation on e26 below the 0.6390 threshold (EV_lost=0.2200).
On day 12 with 7 actions left and 2 days remaining to let narrow canaries c8 and c9 resolve, the agent prematurely accused e26 at P_accused=0.4487 vs threshold 0.5650 (EV_lost=0.2057).
